title: GenASPEN: An Agentic AI Framework for Automatic Performance Modeling and Prediction of HPC Codes
data:
G McLewee, MAH Monil, P Valero-Lara, N Miniskar- 2026 IEEE International, 2026
This paper introduces GenASPEN, a collaborative AI agentic ecosystem for 
automatic performance modeling and prediction. To our knowledge, GenASPEN is 
the first system to integrate generative AI, analytical modeling, and human expertise 
in a unified agentic workflow for automatic performance modeling of high 
performance computing (HPC) applications. It includes a code translation agent that 
leverages both a finetuned model and a context-aware chain-of-thought reasoning
